rationale: The winning script already has staged reverse-tail recurrence, but its ramp is normalized by ITERATIONS=20000, so a 600s Mac-mini run stops around the 700-800 step region before the penultimate recurrent block ever ramps above its minimum gain. This keeps the same architecture, final exact int8+zlib evaluation, quant-aware endgame, and fixed shapes, but normalizes the existing recurrence curriculum to a 900-step local budget so the second recurrent tail block is mostly awake by the quant-aware phase. It directly reduces the train/eval recurrence-gain mismatch without adding validation or spending artifact bytes.
title: Step-Budgeted Reverse-Tail Recurrence Ramp
